category: 髮絲整理狀態 (Hair Styling State)

entries.en: sleek close-to-head roots, restrained volume, compact hair silhouette, fine aligned strands, smooth uniform texture with a soft natural sheen, clean tapered ends, neatly framing the face
entries.desc: 乾淨控制版：髮根服貼、髮量收斂、髮絲排列整齊，降低毛躁、亂髮與過度膨鬆。

entries.en: sleek wet finish, defined damp sections, neat separated strands, controlled close-to-head shape
entries.desc: 濕感版：以清楚分束與受控的服貼輪廓呈現濕髮，不主動增加風吹動態。

entries.en: lightly wind-swept movement, gentle directional flow, a few naturally loose strands, controlled overall silhouette
entries.desc: 微風版：只有輕微方向性與少量鬆散髮絲，整體髮型輪廓仍保持穩定。

entries.en: strong directional wind, visibly lifted and swept strands, pronounced flowing movement, dynamic but coherent silhouette
entries.desc: 強風版：明確的受風方向與被吹起的髮絲，保留整體輪廓一致，避免隨機爆量亂髮。
不指定髮絲整理狀態，保留已選髮型與髮色。
